hypotheses.description: Launch the beam inward from the emitter border, giving top and bottom borders precedence at corners. Reflect at the two mirror colors, stop at walls or the grid edge, and color traversed empty cells orange.
hypotheses.name: border_inward_launch
hypotheses.program: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (define emitter (first (find-color g 2))) (define start-r (first emitter)) (define start-c (second emitter)) (define start-dir (cond ((= start-r 0) (list 1 0)) ((= start-r (- (rows g) 1)) (list -1 0)) ((= start-c 0) (list 0 1)) (else (list 0 -1)))) (let loop ((r start-r) (c start-c) (dr (first start-dir)) (dc (second start-dir)) (out g) (fuel (* 4 (rows g) (cols g)))) (if (= fuel 0) out (let ((nr (+ r dr)) (nc (+ c dc))) (cond ((not (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))) out) ((= (at g nr nc) 8) out) ((= (at g nr nc) 4) (loop nr nc (- dc) (- dr) out (- fuel 1))) ((= (at g nr nc) 5) (loop nr nc dc dr out (- fuel 1))) (else (loop nr nc dr dc (if (= (at g nr nc) 0) (set-cell out nr nc 7) out) (- fuel 1)))))))))
